pages.title: Ten o’clock coffee · 1/3
paragraphs: It is ten o’clock in a busy office in Chicago. Computers hum and phones ring everywhere. Ana walks to the small coffee corner with an empty cup. The machine hisses and the room smells like fresh coffee. Her coworker Jo is already there with a blue mug. They smile at each other.
“Hi, Ana! Are you having your usual coffee?” says Jo. “Yes. I always take my coffee with milk.” says Ana. “Really? I usually take mine black.” says Jo.
